defect.q: What if my item has a defect?
defect.a: Please contact us at info@tcdashop.com within 14 days of receiving your order. We will arrange a replacement or refund after verification. However, EU/UK consumers have a statutory 14-day right of withdrawal from delivery; return shipping is at the customer's cost. Australian consumers: our goods come with guarantees that cannot be excluded under the Australian Consumer Law. You are entitled to a replacement or refund for a major failure and compensation for any other reasonably foreseeable loss or damage. You are also entitled to have the goods repaired or replaced if the goods fail to be of acceptable quality and the failure does not amount to a major failure.

sizeGuide.title: Size Guide
sizeGuide.pageIntro: All measurements in cm (toggle available). Find your fit using the guide below.
sizeGuide.measureChest: Measure around the fullest part of your chest, keeping the tape horizontal.
sizeGuide.measureLength: Measure from the highest point of the shoulder down to the hem.
sizeGuide.measureShoulder: Measure from shoulder seam to shoulder seam across the back.
sizeGuide.measureSleeve: Measure from the shoulder seam down to the cuff.
sizeGuide.faq1q: How do I find my size?
sizeGuide.faq1a: Compare your body measurements to our size chart. If between sizes, size up for a relaxed fit or size down for a fitted look.
sizeGuide.faq2q: What is the difference between body measurements and garment measurements?
sizeGuide.faq2a: Body measurements are yours. Garment measurements are the actual dimensions of the piece. The difference is the ease.
sizeGuide.faq3q: I'm between sizes. What should I do?
sizeGuide.faq3a: For oversized or relaxed fits, size down. For slim fits, size up. When in doubt, refer to the model info on the product page.
sizeGuide.faq4q: Do the sizes run large or small?
sizeGuide.faq4a: Sizing varies by product type. Check the fit label on each product page for guidance.
sizeGuide.faq5a: Size exchanges and returns due to a different image than expected are not accepted. However, EU/UK consumers have a statutory 14-day right of withdrawal from delivery; return shipping is at the customer's cost. Please check the size guide before purchasing.
sizeGuide.faq6a: Measurements are taken flat and may vary ±1–2 cm due to production tolerances.
sizeGuide.faq7a: A slim fit follows the body closely. We recommend sizing up if you prefer more ease.
sizeGuide.faq8a: Oversized pieces are intentionally large. The silhouette is designed to fall away from the body.
sizeGuide.faq9q: Do you offer sizing guidance for unisex pieces?
sizeGuide.faq9a: Unisex pieces are sized to fit all bodies. Check the model info on the product page for reference.
sizeGuide.faq10q: Are measurements in cm or inches?
sizeGuide.faq10a: Both are available. Use the toggle on the size guide to switch between cm and inches.
sizeGuide.faq11q: What if the size guide is not yet available for a product?
sizeGuide.faq11a: We are adding size guides for all products. Check back soon, or contact us for guidance.
sizeGuide.faq12q: How should I care for my piece?
sizeGuide.faq12a: Machine wash cold, gentle cycle. Do not tumble dry. Iron inside out on low heat.

dataCollection.title: 1. Information We Collect
dataCollection.body: We collect your name, shipping address, email address, phone number (if provided), and order details. Payment information is processed by Stripe, Inc. and is not retained by us. If you submit the withdrawal form, we also collect your order number, email address, name, message, language, and the time of receipt. We also receive technical information through Cloudflare, such as access logs and cookies.

legalBasis.title: 2. Legal Basis for Processing
legalBasis.body: We process your data to perform our contract with you (orders, shipping, withdrawals, and refunds) and to meet legal obligations such as accounting and tax records. We also rely on our legitimate interests in security, fraud prevention, and rate limiting. Where we use analytics and advertising cookies or send newsletters, we rely on your consent.

dataUsage.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
dataUsage.body: Collected information is used for order processing, shipping, customer support, and service improvement. We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with the service providers listed below, within the purposes described here, or where required by law.

thirdParty.title: 4. Third-Party Sharing
thirdParty.body: To provide our service, we share necessary data with Printful (manufacturing and shipping), Stripe (payments), Resend (transactional email), Cloudflare (network and security), our server hosting provider in Japan, Anthropic (translation of Japanese shipping addresses, including the recipient's name, for orders shipped to Japan), and Sentry (error monitoring, with personal data masked). For analytics and advertising measurement we use Google Analytics, the Meta Pixel (Meta Platforms) and Microsoft Clarity (see Cookies). We share data with no one else except as required by law.

transfers.title: 5. International Transfers
transfers.body: Your data is processed on our servers in Japan and by the service providers above, which may be located in the United States and other countries. For users in the EU and the UK, where required, transfers rely on safeguards such as standard contractual clauses or adequacy decisions.

retention.title: 6. Retention
retention.body: Order and payment records are kept for 7 years. Withdrawal requests are kept for 3 years. Newsletter data is kept until you unsubscribe.

cookies.title: 7. Cookies
cookies.body: This site uses Google Analytics (GA4, via Google Tag Manager), the Meta Pixel (measurement of advertising and conversions) and Microsoft Clarity (usage analytics, including recordings of how pages are used). If you are in the EU, EEA, UK or Switzerland, a banner asks for your consent, and analytics and advertising cookies are not set until you accept. Elsewhere, they are active by default. You can block cookies in your browser without affecting your ability to use the site.

security.title: 8. Data Security
security.body: Personal information is managed with appropriate security measures to prevent unauthorized access, leaks, or tampering.

rights.title: 9. Your Rights
rights.body: You may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, or portability of your data, object to its processing, and withdraw your consent at any time. You may also lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority. To exercise these rights, contact info@tcdashop.com.

contact.title: 10. Contact
contact.body: For inquiries regarding your personal information, please contact us at info@tcdashop.com. The data controller is the operator named on our Legal page.
